## Research Question

How did my daily screen time vary over two weeks, and how much did each of the five apps contribute to each day's total?

## Data

I recorded daily usage of Xiaohongshu, Fanqie Novel, QQ, Douyin, and WeChat from October 12 to October 25, 2026. The dataset contains 70 observations. Each observation represents one app on one day. Usage is measured in minutes.

Source: Apple Screen Time.

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)

csv_path <- if (file.exists("pvj/screen_time.csv")) {
  "pvj/screen_time.csv"
} else {
  "screen_time.csv"
}

screen_time <- read.csv(csv_path) |>
  mutate(plot_date = mdy(date))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 7.5
#| fig-alt: >
#|   Stacked bars show daily screen time across five apps from October 12 to 25, 2026.
#|   The dashed line marks the daily average of 391 minutes. The three highest
#|   totals were 731 minutes on October 12, 653 on October 21, and 613 on October 25.

daily_totals <- screen_time |>
  group_by(plot_date) |>
  summarize(total = sum(minutes, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

avg_time <- mean(daily_totals$total)

high_days <- daily_totals |>
  slice_max(total, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE)

app_colors <- c(
  "Douyin" = "#D55E00",
  "Fanqie Novel" = "#F0E442",
  "QQ" = "#009E73",
  "WeChat" = "#0072B2",
  "Xiaohongshu" = "#CC79A7"
)

screen_time_plot <- ggplot(
  screen_time,
  aes(x = plot_date, y = minutes, fill = app)
) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  geom_hline(
    data = data.frame(average = avg_time),
    aes(yintercept = average, linetype = "average"),
    color = "gray25",
    linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = high_days,
    aes(x = plot_date, y = total, shape = "top_days"),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = high_days,
    aes(x = plot_date, y = total, label = paste0(total, " min")),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    vjust = -0.9,
    size = 3.6
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = app_colors, guide = guide_legend(position = "top")) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(average = "dashed"),
    labels = paste0("Daily average (", round(avg_time), " min)"),
    guide = guide_legend(order = 1, theme = theme(legend.key.width = grid::unit(23, "pt")))
  ) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    name = NULL,
    values = c(top_days = 16),
    labels = "Three highest-use days",
    guide = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  scale_x_date(
    breaks = sort(daily_totals$plot_date),
    date_labels = "%m/%d",
    expand = expansion(add = 0.5)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.12))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste0("My Screen Time Peaked at ", max(high_days$total), " Minutes"),
    subtitle = "Daily totals across five apps | October 12–25, 2026",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Screen time (minutes)",
    fill = "App",
    caption = "Jiwei | November 18, 2026 | Source: Apple Screen Time"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#E2E5E9", linewidth = 0.45),
    panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#EDF0F3", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 9),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.box = "horizontal",
    legend.justification.bottom = "left",
    legend.spacing.x = grid::unit(17, "pt")
  )

screen_time_plot
```

```{r}
#| include: false

ggsave(
  filename = "screen_time_final.png",
  plot = screen_time_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 7.5,
  units = "in",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```
